title: Assumption Checks
summary: Check normality with Shapiro–Wilk and Q–Q plots, and equal variances with Levene's test, the SPSS way and the car way.
hints: `control <- survey$anxiety_post[survey$group == "Control"]`, then `shapiro.test(control)$p.value`. shapiro.test() drops NAs itself.
`leveneTest(anxiety_post ~ factor(group), data = survey)` uses the median; add `center = mean` to match SPSS.
A Levene result is a small table: the p-value is `levene_mean$"Pr(>F)"[1]`. For the plot: `qqnorm(control)` then `qqline(control)`.
